title: Adachi and Shimamura
synopsis: The second floor of the gym. That’s our spot. Class is in session right now, but they don’t hold class in a place like this. This is where Shimamura and I became friends. What is this feeling? Yesterday, I dreamed of kissing her. I’m not like that, and I’m sure Shimamura isn’t either. But…when Shimamura thinks of the word “friend,” I want to be the first thing that comes to her mind. That’s all. (Source: Yen Press)

Two People in Love with HG
synopsis: When she was 14, Sayaka Kanzaki had her first encounter with Gundam, and her fascination for MS was awakened as if by fate. But her family and friends did not understand the hobby, so she had to hide her interest from the world. Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category. - Includes 15 extra chapters.

synopsis: “Screw all your lip service! I'll go down in history as a villainess!” Me, the same girl who hates all those prim and proper heroines, got reincarnated as the villainess in the world of my favorite fantasy dating sim! It's my dream come true, so I'm going to leave my mark on history by becoming the world's greatest villainess! But to do that, I'll need to get a lot stronger and smarter. Just one problem—the harder I try to be evil, the harder the prince falls for me! At this rate, will I ever get to earn my place in history?! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Ware wa Kenou!!
synopsis: Yoshiaki is entering a school that is famous for its fights and violence. He chose to go there for just that reason, and he intends to be the strongest one there. When he first arrives, he helps out a girl called Homura, who is being picked on by some guys. When she asks him to be her "sword" afterward, Yoshiaki doesn't know how to respond. Apparently, students of the school team up in pairs; a "sword" and a "master". Others advise him not to associate with the girl, who is a "Rank F", as she probably won't live very long. However, Yoshiake is not thrilled with the idea of abandoning her to die.

title: Kariel the Warrior
synopsis: In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secret organizations move in the shadows. Traveling with his childhood friend Reina, Kariel is drawn into a dangerous mystery that may determine the fate of the world. (Source: WEBTOON)

synopsis: Katagiri Natsuomi, a high school student living alone for two years, has a beautiful black-haired, blue-eyed girl move into the next room. The girl, Yui, is actual nobility, and her nickname is “Cool-de-rella” because of her indifferent attitude at school. When Natsuomi finds out that Yui doesn’t want to rely on others, but is actually quite naive, he decides to help her out. This is the beginning of a sweet and tantalizing relationship between two neighbors.

Tomorrow, I Will be Someone's Girlfriend
synopsis: "One time a week, I will be the girlfriend of [someone]." A bitter love story depicting the realities of love between female college students who earn money on behalf of her and men attracted by her. The first volume is a young office worker who rents the protagonist snow as a fake girlfriend, and draws a distorted love pattern of sota and snow. A substitute girl who plays the customer and the woman of their ideals to the end... Is the distance between two people's mind really close? Notes: - Winner of the 68th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shōjo Category - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.
